clarificationQuestions.question: Your schedule row reads "Feb 21/28 Mid-Term exam [assigned/due]". Is the mid-term assigned on 21 February and due on 28 February?
clarificationQuestions.why: Those are two different dates for one exam, and which one goes in the plan changes when you need to be ready.

clarificationQuestions.question: Two rows in your schedule have a placeholder instead of a date: "Feb xx/16" and "Apr 04/xx". What are those dates?
clarificationQuestions.why: Anything due in those weeks cannot be placed on a calendar until the missing day is known.

clarificationQuestions.question: The syllabus lists "Story-mapping projects" as 15% of the grade but never gives a due date or says how many there are. When are they due?
clarificationQuestions.why: It is 15% of your grade with nothing on the calendar, so nothing is being planned for it.

clarificationQuestions.question: Response assignments are described as weekly but no dates or total count are given. Is one due every week the class meets?
clarificationQuestions.why: Without a count or a day the app cannot turn the rule into individual pieces of work to plan.
